# runwayml.comReviews
## Product
Customers consistently note negative experiences with product, reporting that videos end up as black screens...

## User experience
Users describe negative interactions with user experience, reporting that the platform quickly burns through...

## Price
Customers had negative experiences with price, reporting that high monthly fees, such as paying $35 or more,...

## Value for money
### Reviews shaping this summary
Inability to cancel. Endless loop of AI trash.

Horrible experience, horrible customer service.

No proper customer support - even though they state human escalation is possible, their chatbot will not allow it.

## All reviews
### Top mentions
MistakeRefundSubscriptionServicePaymentSpamCustomer serviceQualityProductCancellation

![Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

And the quality is not that great.

![Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

[**Extremely expensive**](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6ae1e9744edd9d9d7cfc251e)

Extremely expensive. Better to find a real person on Fiverr or something. 5-7 pounds for an AI video? I will be cancelling and looking for alternatives.

![Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

Support case #252635 refused a credit restore (“cannot refund… iterative generative tools”) and never named a free Upscale-to-4K path.

![Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

You ask one of the tools to do something 10 times, but it doesn't do it while chipping away at your credit. The first time I've cancelled my plan on the same day I paid for it.

![Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

[**I would give this 0 if I could**](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6ae03d70c43680be08b0b646)

I would give this 0 if I could. Dont even bother, I paid and didnt even get to produce a video and just said you dont have enough to create this video and asking to purchase more.

![Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

[**It worked AMAZING for about two days**](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6adfe4c3e734a1186983377f)

My last use it literally delivered the exact same video after I spent a half hour making prompt modifications. The result didn't deliver most of what you asked for, and I told you it was finished without checking it first. That was my mistake." Uhhhh, ok, how about a refund then? That sounds borderline fraudulence to me. I'm paying for a service and you're admitting that you didn't do any of it. I would have spent 100's if not 1000's with this company had it delivered properly. On to the next I guess.

![Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

[**Runway AI is extremely expensive**](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6add69a6ea7bc57714af82ee)

Runway AI is extremely expensive, and its pricing simply doesn't make sense. Despite having 732 available credits, I couldn't generate a basic 20–25-second video through its ChatGPT integration. The restrictions are confusing, and the cost is unreasonable for what you get. I wasted valuable time trying to make it work. Very disappointing experience and poor value for money. I would not recommend it.

![Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

[**Paid for Pro, didn't get anything..**](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6adb71ece3d91e4d930b9c2c)

**Paid for Pro, but my professional dance videos kept getting rejected**

Unfortunately, the platform repeatedly rejected my videos for alleged nudity or content policy violations, even though I was wearing a standard professional dance costume and performing a traditional artistic choreography.

I spent hours shortening videos, rewriting prompts, waiting for generations and trying different settings.

The experience was extremely frustrating and time-consuming. I paid for a service that I could barely use for its intended purpose.

I have cancelled my subscription and requested a refund. But I didn't get it for some vague reason.

Very disappointing experience. I cannot recommend it for professional dance video editing.

![Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

I was told it would be only $12 for a month of usage, so I paid the $12. I generated the first video, which it was incorrect, so I generated it at least three other times before it got correct, and then it told me I only had enough for one additional video, thinking I used my $12 up already. I then noticed my bank account was charged $158. I immediately called my bank, canceled my membership, and had them refund me with the exception of the $12 I used.

Content policies and regulations for consumers but I bet their billionaire trust fund nepo baby children get unlimited resources and zero restrictions. Don't bother paying for this service. These adults are lobotomized and brain washed.

Rather just learn 3D software at this point and go open-source for a better experience.

### See if a website is trustworthy without leaving the page
The poor quality of the AI generation combined with predatory, difficult cancellation hurdles left me with zero desire to ever use this platform again.

The company feels completely empty, run by AI chatbots with no real customer support, just fake promises and misleading claims.

Unfortunately, even after paying, my account remained on the Standard plan.

The customer service has been incredibly disappointing.

I haven’t used Runway’s AI-generated output enough to judge its overall quality, but based on my experience with its customer support, I simply cannot rely on the service.

Analogy: asking a builder to do some work, only for the builder to charge you for doing the exact opposite to what you instructed them to do but still charging you for the priviledge.
